title: Parabolas and rates of change
summary: Sketching parabolas by transformations, factorising, completing the square and the discriminant, line–parabola intersections, rates of change, and direct and inverse variation.

cards.title: Exploring parabolas
cards.rule: \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\): axis of symmetry \(x = -\tfrac{b}{2a}\), y-intercept \(c\).

cards.title: Sketching with transformations
cards.rule: \(y = a(x - h)^2 + k\) has turning point \((h, k)\).

cards.title: Sketching using factorisation
cards.rule: Factorise for the x-intercepts. The turning point is halfway between them.

cards.title: Sketching by completing the square
cards.rule: Complete the square to read off the turning point.

cards.title: The quadratic formula and discriminant
cards.rule: \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) tells you how many x-intercepts.

cards.title: Applications of parabolas
cards.rule: The maximum or minimum is at the turning point.
lines: 40 m of fence: \(A = x(20 - x)\), biggest at \(x = 10\): \(100\) m²

cards.title: Lines and parabolas
cards.rule: Set the equations equal and solve. The discriminant tells you how many points they share.

cards.title: Rates of change
cards.rule: Rate \(= \dfrac{\text{change in } y}{\text{change in } x}\), in units per unit.
lines: The gradient of a distance–time graph is the speed

cards.title: Average and instantaneous rates
cards.rule: Average: gradient of the chord between two points. Instantaneous: gradient of the tangent at one point.

cards.title: Direct and inverse variation
cards.rule: Direct: \(y = kx\). Inverse: \(y = \tfrac kx\). Find \(k\) first.
